modules.name: ontologylab
modules.rationale: Package __init__ exposing only version metadata; no pipeline logic.

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors
modules.rationale: Package __init__ docstring-only marker for the Acquire connector group.

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.allowlist
modules.rationale: Deny-by-default host/URL/query gates defining which evidence sources may be fetched.

secondary_stages.why: check_collect_file gates local staged-file ingestion, an Acquire-time boundary
loggable_collect_inputs bounds/scrubs values logged before validation

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.base
modules.rationale: Defines the Connector Protocol fetch slot and the RawDocument boundary type for acquire.

secondary_stages.why: RawDocument.dedupe_key implements DOI-first work identity for acquired items
collapse_duplicates merges same-work batches during ingest

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.dedup
modules.rationale: Cross-source same-work merging, the canonical-form dedup step of acquire output.

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.fulltext
modules.rationale: Fetches and flattens full-text XML bytes from allowlisted endpoints.

secondary_stages.why: jats_to_text converts fetched JATS XML into canonical flat text

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.paper_api
modules.rationale: The paper-source Connector implementation fetching records across publisher APIs.

secondary_stages.why: check_source_implemented and fetch_hosts define which paper sources exist
fetch canonicalizes query and re-checks the allowlist before any URL is built

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.registry_lookup
modules.rationale: Advisory registry lookup (UniProt/PubChem/ClinVar) resolving proposed entity names for review.

secondary_stages.why: _get performs the bounded HTTP fetch of registry records

hidden_fallbacks.what: Fetch uses urllib.request.urlopen on hardcoded hosts (36-38) and never calls connectors.allowlist.check_url (ontologylab/connectors/allowlist.py:112): an Acquire path outside the deny-by-default allowlist gate, reachable from ontologylab/server/routes.py:1867

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.resources
modules.rationale: Fetches curated bio-resource records (UniProt/MyGene/Ensembl/ChEMBL) by name.

secondary_stages.why: parse_uniprot resolves a symbol to a registry identifier and match payload
lookup feeds enrichment synthesis of verified nodes

modules.name: ontologylab.connectors.web_crawl
modules.rationale: Fetches explicit allowlisted URLs and converts HTML to text records.

secondary_stages.why: html_to_text strips markup into the canonical text form

modules.name: ontologylab.engines
modules.rationale: Engine adapter layer: one generate() slot with Mock/Claude/Codex/Gemini/Api implementations and the get_engine factory.

secondary_stages.why: _mock_critic emits deterministic critic scores for the Verify stage
_mock_extraction emits deterministic proposed entities/relations for the Extract stage

hidden_fallbacks.what: CLI --engine defaults to 'mock' (also ontologylab/main.py:1999 critic, ontologylab/main.py:2165 search): an unset engine silently selects the CamelCase scanner on real prose instead of the declared DEFAULT_ENGINE='claude' (ontologylab/paths.py:20)

engine_slot.interface: ontologylab.models.Engine Protocol: async generate(prompt, *, model) -> tuple[str, dict] (ontologylab/models.py:285, generate at ontologylab/models.py:292)

modules.name: ontologylab.evidence
modules.rationale: Classifies each acquired record into a coarse evidence grade (peer_reviewed/preprint/registration/other/unknown).

secondary_stages.why: normalize grades are surfaced to the human reviewer so approval is not blind to record kind

modules.name: ontologylab.http_bound
modules.rationale: Bound HTTP helper enforcing response-size cap and exact-origin redirect refusal.

modules.name: ontologylab.keychain
modules.rationale: macOS Keychain credential read/write/resolve for publisher API keys.

secondary_stages.why: _try_migrate transparently migrates legacy-service secrets to the v2 service

hidden_fallbacks.what: read_key silently falls back to the legacy keychain service (_read_legacy at ontologylab/keychain.py:257) when the native v2 read misses: an implicit credential fallback path

modules.name: ontologylab.kgstore
modules.rationale: Owns the sqlite KG: schema, transactions, and every stage's persistence, but also embeds Verify/Consume/Publish/Resolve/Synthesize logic inline (god-object, see secondary_stages and findings).

secondary_stages.why: _migrate (791-918) alters columns for cutover, _migrate_ontology_terms (919-1053) and _backfill_legacy_ontology_terms (1054-1094) migrate the legacy vocabulary: storage-lifecycle DDL lives inside the store

approve/reject/quarantine/retract_review/compensate_review/approve_with_grounding_waiver/reopen/invalidate_edge (2937-3266), bulk_approve (3267), decide_annotation (3503), record_critic_review (4217): proposal approval and review decisions are store methods, not a stage module
name_search (4926), semantic_search (4972), vector_search (5102), hybrid_search (5201), graph_query (5310), find_path (5478): search/retrieval implemented as inline SQL inside the store
verified_subgraph (4751-4772) selects and exports the pack payload: pack-export logic lives in the store
record_merge_candidate (3357), merge_nodes (3657-3940), dismiss_merge_candidate (3639): merge/entity-resolution decisions are store methods
upsert_enrichment (4352), list_enrichments (4372), list_communities (4683), write_communities (4720): enrichment and community synthesis state lives in the store
insert_proposed (2593-2802) validates and persists extraction proposals produced by the Extract stage
insert_document (2029-2164) canonicalizes documents, enforcing the DOI-unique identity (idx_documents_doi)
open (703-790), _SCHEMA DDL (211-540), install_schema (1294): the legitimate storage/schema core

hidden_fallbacks.what: _vec_available falls back to brute-force cosine when the sqlite-vec extension is absent; same-result but silently degrades the retrieval path

modules.name: ontologylab.main
modules.rationale: The CLI entrypoint surface; 39 add_parser sites (~42 leaf subcommands) with substantial pipeline logic inlined in cmd_* instead of stage modules.

secondary_stages.why: cmd_collect runs allowlist gates and connector fetches inline
_extract_async builds Caps/KillSwitch and drives run_extraction inline
cmd_review/approve/reject/quarantine print and drive the human review gate inline
cmd_build_pack orchestrates pack build and print inline
cmd_merge_scan drives merge candidate scan inline
cmd_method compiles method workspaces inline

hidden_fallbacks.what: cmd_search silently falls back to lexical search when the embedder is unavailable or embeddings mismatch
cmd_search keeps RRF order when the reranker is uncached: silent retrieval degradation
extract --engine default='mock' (also critic 1999, search 2165) silently selects the mock scanner instead of paths.DEFAULT_ENGINE

modules.name: ontologylab.models
modules.rationale: Shared dataclasses (Document, proposals, terms, PackManifest) and the Engine Protocol boundary.

secondary_stages.why: Engine Protocol declares the engine slot's generate() contract

modules.name: ontologylab.ontology_schema
modules.rationale: Default ontology definition constants and term IRI/lifecycle vocabulary.

modules.name: ontologylab.paths
modules.rationale: Data/pack/job/registry path derivation, offline kill-switch mode, and engine defaults.

secondary_stages.why: assert_network_allowed enforces the offline egress kill switch

modules.name: ontologylab.provenance
modules.rationale: Append-only run provenance JSONL plus status snapshot and usage accounting.

modules.name: ontologylab.providers
modules.rationale: API provider registry: load/validate/save credentials with restrictive file modes.

secondary_stages.why: resolve_api_key selects the key source for an engine adapter

modules.name: ontologylab.safety
modules.rationale: Run-loop safety primitives: Caps budgets and KillSwitch sentinel/signal handling.

modules.name: ontologylab.schemas
modules.rationale: Bundled ontology preset schema definitions for KGStore.install_schema.

modules.name: ontologylab.server
modules.rationale: Package __init__ docstring-only marker for the FastAPI dashboard server.

modules.name: ontologylab.server.app
modules.rationale: FastAPI app assembly: middleware, session install, router registration, static web UI.

secondary_stages.why: serves the bundled web dashboard as the human consume surface

modules.name: ontologylab.server.dependencies
modules.rationale: Request-scoped AppDependencies container wiring data_dir, settings, and job registry.

modules.name: ontologylab.server.ingest_routes
modules.rationale: Internal authority-write ingestion endpoints over the shared ingestion seam (run_ingest/collect_sample).

secondary_stages.why: reconcile_files + project_outbox complete the normalize lifecycle after ingest

modules.name: ontologylab.server.jobs
modules.rationale: Background extraction job registry; _extract_async is an explicit mirror of main._extract_async.

secondary_stages.why: _research_async collect phase runs formulate_scholarly_queries + fetch_sources + ingest fan-out inline
corpus_summary + write_corpus_artifacts synthesize the retrieved corpus before extraction

modules.name: ontologylab.server.rate_limit
modules.rationale: In-memory windowed rate limiter for the provider test endpoint.

modules.name: ontologylab.server.routes
modules.rationale: 85-route FastAPI surface for the dashboard; search/chat/review/publish endpoints that mostly delegate but with inline pipeline logic in collect/enrich/chat.

secondary_stages.why: collect implements the full acquire pipeline inline: gate order, connector fan-out, ingest_documents
approve_proposal and the proposal action routes drive the human review gate
packs_build/packs_build_mcpb orchestrate pack publication
merge_scan/merge_candidate_merge and reconcile_* routes drive identity resolution
enrich_nodes and communities routes surface synthesis results
start_extract/start_research spawn extraction jobs
create_source writes source credentials to the Keychain inline

hidden_fallbacks.what: translate_visible_text iterates claude->codex->gemini in order when engine=='auto': an implicit engine failover chain
_run_intent calls sibling route functions (search_entities, enrich_nodes, packs_build, start_research) directly: cross-route invocation hides a second dispatch path inside chat

modules.name: ontologylab.server.schemas
modules.rationale: Pydantic request/response models for the HTTP surface.

modules.name: ontologylab.server.security
modules.rationale: Host-header trust checks and cross-site state-change protection for the local server.

modules.name: ontologylab.server.session
modules.rationale: Single-user session token minting, persistence, and comparison.

modules.name: ontologylab.server.settings
modules.rationale: Server settings persistence, environment application, engine availability, and cost summary.

secondary_stages.why: engines() computes which engine names the UI may offer

hidden_fallbacks.what: engines() always lists mock as available, and the chat composer falls through to mock when CLI engines report unavailable: an implicit mock fallback in the consume surface

modules.name: ontologylab.trace
modules.rationale: Structured Step events for job/progress tracing.

findings: kgstore.py (5587 LOC) is a god-object: the single class KGStore (kgstore.py:603) holds logic for 9 of the 11 canonical stages. Verify: approve..invalidate_edge (kgstore.py:2937-3266) + decide_annotation (kgstore.py:3503) + record_critic_review (kgstore.py:4217). Consume: name_search..find_path (kgstore.py:4926-5567). Publish: verified_subgraph pack export (kgstore.py:4751). Resolve: merge_nodes (kgstore.py:3657-3940). Synthesize: communities/enrichments (kgstore.py:4352-4739). Extract: insert_proposed (kgstore.py:2593). Normalize: insert_document (kgstore.py:2029). cross-cutting: migration DDL _migrate (kgstore.py:791-1094). Only Acquire and Source live outside it.

main.py is a CLI mega-layer, not a thin Consume surface: 39 add_parser call sites (~42 leaf subcommands incl. reconcile x6, method x5, registry x3, provider x4) and 38 in-function lazy imports. Pipeline logic lives in the CLI: cmd_collect re-implements allowlist gates + connector fan-out (ontologylab/main.py:483), _extract_async builds Caps/KillSwitch and drives extraction (ontologylab/main.py:619), cmd_search inlines query expansion + hybrid search (ontologylab/main.py:1497), cmd_build_pack orchestrates publication (ontologylab/main.py:1287).

server/routes.py has 85 routes and several implement pipeline logic inline instead of delegating: collect re-implements the entire acquire pipeline (gates, fan-out, ingest_documents) at ontologylab/server/routes.py:1894-2090; enrich_proposal does registry lookup inline (ontologylab/server/routes.py:1859); chat/_run_intent re-dispatches through sibling route functions (ontologylab/server/routes.py:2390). Duplicated CLI pairs with different code paths: routes.collect (ontologylab/server/routes.py:1894) vs main.cmd_collect (ontologylab/main.py:483); routes.critic_run (ontologylab/server/routes.py:1296) vs main.cmd_critic (ontologylab/main.py:1048); routes.merge_scan (ontologylab/server/routes.py:1378) vs main.cmd_merge_scan (ontologylab/main.py:1195); routes.packs_build (ontologylab/server/routes.py:2715) vs main.cmd_build_pack (ontologylab/main.py:1287); ingest_routes.ingest_authority (ingest_routes.py:25) vs main.cmd_ingest (ontologylab/main.py:447); server.jobs._extract_async (jobs.py:707) is an acknowledged mirror of main._extract_async (ontologylab/main.py:619).

Engine slot is well-shaped (models.Engine Protocol generate(prompt,*,model) at ontologylab/models.py:285; Mock/Claude/Codex/Gemini/Api engines at ontologylab/engines.py:483/534/566/594/706; factory get_engine at ontologylab/engines.py:890), but default resolution is split and a hidden fallback exists: ontologylab/paths.py:20 declares DEFAULT_ENGINE='claude' while the CLI --engine defaults to 'mock' (ontologylab/main.py:398, ontologylab/main.py:1999, ontologylab/main.py:2165) and settings.engines() documents the chat composer silently falling through to mock (settings.py:135).

Acquire slot exists (Connector Protocol at connectors/base.py:157; implementations PaperApiConnector paper_api.py:1634, WebCrawlConnector web_crawl.py:118; fulltext uses module functions not the protocol), but registry_lookup bypasses the Source allowlist: it hardcodes registry hosts (registry_lookup.py:36-38) and fetches via urllib.request.urlopen (registry_lookup.py:66) without connectors.allowlist.check_url (ontologylab/connectors/allowlist.py:112), reachable from the /review/{node_id}/enrich route (ontologylab/server/routes.py:1867).

Two parallel registry-lookup implementations exist: connectors/resources.py lookup() (resources.py:371, used by enrichment.py:160) and connectors/registry_lookup.py lookup_entity() (registry_lookup.py:180, used by ontologylab/server/routes.py:1867) with overlapping registry coverage (UniProt/PubChem), duplicating Resolve fetch logic.

main.py cmd_search contains three silent fallbacks in one function: expansion fails open to the raw query (ontologylab/main.py:1523), embedder failure falls back to lexical (ontologylab/main.py:1526), reranker miss keeps RRF order (ontologylab/main.py:1552): hidden retrieval degradation with no typed boundary.
